answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 9103 Country: India Title: My question is what is hadish-e-qudshiya (Hadish-e-Qudshi), please sir explain me in detail. Question: Ashlamu Alaiykum janab Mufti saheb, My question is what is hadish-e-qudshiya (Hadish-e-Qudshi), please sir explain me in detail. May Allah Bless you and your family, thanks Answer ID: 9103 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2076/1907=D/1429) Hadith Qudsi is a Hadith spoken by the Prophet ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) while being attributed to Allah Almighty, such as: عن أبي هريرة عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال : قال الله عزوجل : سبقت رحمتى غضبي Hadhrat Abu Hurairah ( رضی اللہ عنہ ) narrates that the Prophet ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) stated: Allah Almighty says: His mercy dominates His anger. (Sahih Muslim) The narration in this Hadith was attributed to Allah (while it was spoken by the Prophet); therefore it is called Hadith Qudsi. Both the words and meanings of the Holy Quran are from Allah Almighty, revealed through the angel Jibreel ( عليه السلام ). In Hadith Qudsi, the words are from the Prophet ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) but their meanings are put into the hearts of the Prophet ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) from Allah, and the Prophet ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) relates it imputing to Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
